assumptions: Rigid twin hulls, calm flat water, open wind, deep seabed.
Displacement-derived mass; assumed CG 2.5m above waterline and column-derived inertia.
Existing CrewRowing, 3 hands per oar as a grouped motor approximation; long-oar inertia and inboard handles are estimates.
Two independent existing SailingSystems; no rig shadowing or catamaran wave interference.
Windage area and rudder area are estimates. No structure, damage, interiors or navigation world.
Optional test drive applies a specified forward force at both hulls near the stern; no paddle or animal mechanism is simulated.
